title: Thunderbird NNTP compatibility smoke test
description: Configure Thunderbird to connect to a running usenet-ipfs-reader (NNTP, no TLS). Subscribe to a test group. Verify group list loads, article list loads via OVER, and article body displays. Document any Thunderbird-specific quirks (e.g., it probes for XOVER before OVER). Why: Thunderbird is the most common desktop NNTP client; compatibility with it validates the reader for real users.
